maria (Docs): Quick flag — product will flip hosted default to redwood-1-rlhf on 2026-04-18. Need a short migration microdoc + update quickstarts and SDK snippets. Who can own?
zoe (Eng): I can sweep examples and runtime docs. I'll grep for 'redwood-1', 'client.generate', 'client.stream', and legacy choices usage. Found some occurrences already.
ben (SDK): Important: v1 -> v2 callsites must change from client.generate() to client.responses.create() and streaming is now an async iterator (responses.stream()). I'll prepare a tiny compatibility shim and canonical streaming snippet for docs.
sam (Support): Please add a one-paragraph support blurb we can paste into tickets — customers are hitting errors about missing choices and old params.
maria (Docs): Timeline: open PRs by 2026-04-13, merge by 2026-04-16 so preview builds exist before deploy. docs-bot: reminder of deploy window?
docs-bot: Docs deploy window 2026-04-17 22:00-23:59 UTC. Request previews before 2026-04-17 21:30 UTC.
maria (Docs): Thanks — I'll draft the migration note (old->new snippet, shim, troubleshooting lines) and link Ben/Zoe's PRs for review.
